verdict.rationale: Gmail has a public developer API with documentation, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question and the axis applies. A probe of https://developers.google.com/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and no evidence shows agent-oriented or LLM-targeted documentation. Ordinary REST API guides are a developer building block and are not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
